```plato

//==
// Linear taper about Axis through Origin: the component perpendicular to the
// axis is scaled by (1 + Rate * t), where t is signed distance along the axis.
// Rate of 0 is the identity; negative Rate pinches.
type Taper3D
    implements IValue, IDeformation3D
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    Axis: Direction3D;
    Rate: Number;
}
```
